checks: Actual unchanged production OwnedStageRunner, StageCommand, _OwnedJob and bootstrap are imported; no copied supervisor or observer modification. Accepted retired-process identity correction is retained.

Fixture is stdlib-only and starts no child processes. Target and sentinel have separate stage IDs, CompletionContexts/nonces, host release/job tokens, private runner instances and native private Job identities.
Outer production Job verifies coordinator membership and current native identity before binary GO. Both stages use unchanged production bootstrap attachment/control ordering.

Readiness requires native image query provenance, creation FILETIME, exact Job owner/handle consistency, current enumerated PID and positive current liveness; cached readiness alone cannot admit cancellation.

Only target event is set for controlled cancellation. Exact target cooperative acknowledgement, zero-success child/bootstrap return codes, natural/unforced empty Job and absence of observer/cleanup errors are required.

Sentinel survival requires unchanged native identity in two sequential snapshots after target settlement: the first creates an observation fence and the strictly later snapshot proves native queries occurred after the fence.

Sentinel receives an independent exact context/stage/PID/release/job-token release file; completed release receipt must also contain succeeded terminal, RELEASE action and original context nonce. Its cancel event must remain unset.
Fixture waits for the exact publisher .writing sibling before enforcing single-link stable release readback; link errors retain durable pending evidence and original exception.
25-second stage timeout is unchanged and successful stage receipts must finish with elapsed_s strictly below25. The source retains both6GiB process/Job caps,12GiB RAM floor and2GiB disk floor.

Outer active/grace/force/hard deadlines derive initial host monotonic time:70/82/87/90 seconds. Watchdog is installed before any Job or worker launch; forced cleanup, nonempty accounting, error, late completion or changed source/interpreter/admission/review permanently blocks PASS.

Wrapper checks same qualified Windows user/SID as actual accepted outside-writer record, rejects enabled Administrator role/SYSTEM/anonymous token, verifies interpreter/host and fresh attempt, and invokes original API Python directly with -B -I -S. No RunAs or permission change.

Expected-context bytes are independently hashed in review and admission, checked by preflight, and checked against actual same-shell wrapper context before attempt reservation. Supported require_escalated execution must still be recorded by the calling tool.
All attempt/results are exclusive publications. Independent diagnostic fallback preserves original exception and does not depend on failed hardlink publication. No retry or second pair is encoded.
The17 focused tests passed once under explicit process/Job construction guards; publication syscall behavior is mocked and not qualified by those tests.
resolved_findings: Post-target native-query temporal ambiguity resolved by sequential observation fence.
Sentinel completed-release terminal/action/context nonce now explicitly validated.
Transient publisher hardlink count handled only while exact staging sibling exists.
Original link failure no longer replaced by cleanup or discards pending evidence.
Private expected user-context bytes are now bound to source admission and independent review.
limits: PASS authorizes the reviewed single synthetic nonrecursive Windows CPU pair only, subject to exact admission and supported outside-sandbox invocation. No native attempt or preflight was executed by this reviewer.

This source/mock review does not claim actual ownership, target cancellation, sentinel survival, successful exit, peak memory, released allocation bytes or native outcome; those require independent saved-outcome review after the sole attempt.
Token evidence is same-shell context plus supported tool override. No independent child-token inspection or sandbox detector is supplied.
Watchdog exists before owned execution; prelaunch filesystem/interpreter latency was not independently benchmarked here.
No UpstreamJob production authority, WSL ownership, neural cancellation, model/GPU inference or fresh-image generation is qualified.
